verdict.rationale: Inngest documents creating any number of unique webhook URLs that consume events from third-party services such as Stripe, GitHub, and Clerk. Those events can then trigger subscribed functions, so the webhook pathway is inbound only. There is no evidence of outbound webhooks that push Inngest's own events (run completions, failures) to a user-specified endpoint, which is the usual meaning of subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: outbound webhook subscriptions for platform events, event filtering and delivery/retry semantics for webhook notifications, independent hands-on corroboration.
